Usage: arcctl dump [--range a:b] [--bin|--json] [-o file]

Read flash and print it as hex, raw bytes or decoded.

Flags:
  -bin
      write raw bytes, unread ones as 0xFF (default range 0:256)
  -json
      print the decoded configuration as JSON
  -o file
      write to file instead of standard output
  -range a:b
      read a:b (end exclusive) or a+n, decimal or 0x hex; default: what the load
      read

Global flags: see 'arcctl help'.
